result.question: Quais sao os 5 hospitais por estado MA e RS com maior taxa de mortalidade em internacoes com UTI, considerando mais de 500 internacoes em UTI?
result.gold_sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT mh."SG_UF" AS uf_hospital, i."CNES", COALESCE(h."NO_HOSPITAL", 'Sem nome cadastrado') AS hospital, COUNT(*) AS total_uti, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mortes_uti, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade_uti FROM internacoes i JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES" JOIN municipios mh ON h."MUNIC_MOV" = mh."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE mh."SG_UF" IN ('MA', 'RS') AND i."MARCA_UTI" <> 0 GROUP BY mh."SG_UF", i."CNES", h."NO_HOSPITAL" HAVING COUNT(*) > 500), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY uf_hospital ORDER BY taxa_mortalidade_uti DESC, total_uti DESC) AS rn FROM agg) SELECT uf_hospital, "CNES", hospital, total_uti, mortes_uti, taxa_mortalidade_uti FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY uf_hospital, rn;
